title: Amplify our words
slide_intent: Introduce typographic voice through the scale and density of letters. A heavy letter on a bright block can recall the immediacy of a placard.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can connect contemporary campaigns to the visual history of activism and make a short message prominent at a distance.
demonstration: Oversized black capitals sit on staggered pink bands over cyan, with white guides and a loose green arrow behind and beside them.
practical_value: Use a heavy display face and concentrated blocks of color to make a short activist headline the first read.

content_islands.name: Chapter introduction
content_islands.spec: Place Amplify our words and the explanation of poster influences in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Display lettering
content_islands.spec: Stack three letter groups across the main area in black capitals. Set pink behind the lines, shift the bands horizontally and keep the cyan ground visible.

content_islands.name: Guides and gesture
content_islands.spec: Overlay fine construction guides and add a loose green loop and arrow to show both the alignment and the gesture surrounding the letters.
